chunks: Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who entered into hajj outside the months of hajj, he said: “He should make it an 'umrah.”

key_terms.فَرَضَ: entered into obligation or assumed the state for the rite
key_terms.يَجْعَلُهَا: he is to treat it or render it as

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone enters into hajj outside the months of hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who assumes hajj outside its designated months. The ruling is that such an act is redirected as an 'umrah, showing the importance of observing the prescribed times of pilgrimage rites.
